Ava (PM): ok team — dropping the company-level OKR draft for the exec pass. trying to keep it crisp, 3 measurable bets. please react with thumbs or comment inline.
Ravi (CTO): looking now. do we have linked success metrics per bet?
Ava (PM): yes — added target ranges. 1) Reduce median text-gen p95 latency by 30% for hosted API. 2) Cut per-token cost for 95pc of workloads by 20% via batching + quantization. 3) Launch Dedicated + Private GA for 2 regulated customers.
Ethan (Eng): 30% p95 is aggressive but doable if we land the new kernel selection and routing in Q2. need dedicated infra weeks.
Priya (Data): can we add an evaluation metric for quality regressions? latency/ cost wins must have quality guardrails.
Ava (PM): good call — adding a Quality Safety KPI: false-positive regression rate <= 1.5% on the canonical prompt set.
Sam (Sales): for the "2 regulated customers" item — does that mean signed contracts? we should say "pilot to GA with 2 reference customers" or Sales will push for MRR language.
Ava (PM): rewrote to "achieve GA readiness and 2 reference customer pilots for Dedicated/Private". agrees?
Lina (CS): CS asks we include SLO docs and runbook creation as part of GA readiness. without runbooks customers stall.
Ben (Finance): cost reduction target looks fine but we need to ensure revenue and margin modeling — can product commit to timeline? finance needs a month-by-month model for Q commit.
Ava (PM): will attach timeline + spreadsheet tomorrow. Ben — will that cover finance needs?
Ben (Finance): yes if it includes cost assumptions by model family and reserved capacity revenue.
Ethan (Eng): priority-wise I propose: kernel selection (M1), routing + fallbacks (M2), batching + caching ops (M3). M1 and M2 are blockers for the 30% p95.
Ravi (CTO): agree with priority. we should scope an MVP for kernel switch that targets the 80% common path first. full coverage can be a follow-up.
Priya (Data): for the quality KPI — can we define the canonical prompt set now? I can pull a draft from last quarter's evals.
Ava (PM): please do. will add as an appendix.
Sam (Sales): minor ask — add a customer-facing launch checklist item: SOC2 and regional data residency notes for Private. 
Lina (CS): +1, and CS wants an internal "readiness sign-off" checklist (docs, runbooks, escalation).
Ava (PM): ok — new doc items: readiness checklist, runbooks, eval appendix, finance model.
Ravi (CTO): one risk: quantization might increase edge-case hallucinations. we should pair the quantization effort with the regression-monitoring pipeline.
Priya (Data): I can own the regression pipeline scope. will include thresholds and alerting.
Ethan (Eng): can we scope a canary policy for model variants? auto-fallback to FP16 when regression spikes.
Ava (PM): adding an A/B + automatic fallback policy under rollouts. 
rollout-bot: deploy plan uploaded: s3://redwood-internal/roadmap/q2/rollout-plan-v1.md
Ava (PM): thanks bot. final ask: if no major objections by EOD tomorrow, i'll bundle this as the "company-OKR draft" and move to executive sign-off meeting on Friday. react with :thumbsup: to approve the draft for the exec meeting, :thumbsdown: to request a hold.
Ravi (CTO): :thumbsup:
Ethan (Eng): :thumbsup: 
Priya (Data): :thumbsup: 
Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: 
Lina (CS): :thumbsup: 
Ben (Finance): :thumbsup: 
Ava (PM): great — thanks everyone. attaching timeline + sheet tomorrow 9am PT.
Ava (PM): postscript — if anything contentious, drop in the doc with comments instead of long thread replies. keeps exec meeting efficient.
